title: Gaia — the laboratory boundary
caption: The world/agent coupling, drawn so that the model/process distinction cannot be missed. Panel I places the laboratory named Gaia — the generative PROCESS, world.process — on the left under hatch, and the agent holding the generative MODEL, model.p_os = p(o,s), on the right. Between them is the Markov blanket b = {s,a}: s is the world's only route in, a is the mind's only route out, and the agent's inference touches nothing else. Inside the agent's internal states hangs a framed miniature, and it is the plate's load-bearing detail: it depicts the BLANKET SURFACE, not the world, because NA-04 says the generative model 'is not a model of eta; it is a model of how eta is expected to show up in b'. A forbidden double-headed path is cut with a cross exactly where it tries to cross the blanket wall — the oracle cut — because any crossing that is not s or a is forbidden. Panel II states the partition formally. Panel III draws the human visual blanket as a funnel to scale in width at exactly 83:1 (498 px mouth / 6 px throat) from measured counts, and marks the ratio MODELED because it divides unpaired cohorts across a non-uniform surface. Panel IV records that one token, 'Gaia', names two different subjects in two different ledgers. Panel V draws the Pearl-to-Friston slide and carries Aguilera's narrow-corner result as a first-class NEGATIVE. Panel VI sets the two emptinesses side by side — NOT-MEASURED in nature against not-yet-built in UNI — separated by a sovereignty mark, because the resemblance is the trap. The Gaia side of this plate carries no number at all: that is a finding, not an omission.

not_claimed: That Gaia exists as a running artifact. Gaia has zero rows in CLAIM-LEDGER; UNI fence: not-yet-built. This plate draws a DESIGN, and a design discharges no gate.

That any agent drawn here has a Markov blanket in the Friston sense. No I(mu;eta|b) has been estimated for any UNI boundary, and NA04-02 cards it NOT-MEASURED for essentially all real biological systems. The blanket on this plate is a partition drawn by a builder — the Pearl kind, the free kind.

That a Markov blanket implies a self, an experiencer, awareness, sentience, consciousness, or a point of view. Explicitly disclaimed in NA-04, and no falsifier is offered because none exists. The same formalism admits partitions for a Newton's cradle, a burning fuse and the Lorenz attractor (Beck & Ramstead 2025). If a blanket implied a self, it would imply one for the burning fuse.

That the free-energy principle is true, or that blanket conditions are general. In the one setting where the question was solved exactly they held only in a 'very narrow space of parameters' (Aguilera et al. 2022) — carried as a first-class NEGATIVE, not softened.

That naming a laboratory 'Gaia' asserts anything about Earth, the biosphere, or a living planet. And not claimed that the Gaia hypothesis is settled — CN03-76 carries regulation as HYPOTHESIZED with the unit-of-selection objection live and unanswered.

That 83 : 1 is a measured ratio, or that the sensory surface is uniform. It is MODELED across unpaired cohorts (NA04-08); foveal ~1:1 against peripheral >>100:1 is the fence, and the drawing is the thing being fenced.

That a low F certifies the model. NA-02, honest bound 1: 'A confidently wrong model can sit at low F ... the whole construction is conditional on p(o,s) — a choice, not a measurement. Minimizing F never tests whether the generative model was the right one.'

That anything here raises any UNI rung. A NATURE CITATION IS NEVER A UNI GATE. The honest program position is unchanged by this plate: ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned, a developmental active-inference SIMULATION, a toy world, never a person.
'Full human' and 'beyond human' are not targets, milestones or deliverables anywhere on this plate — they are permanent open questions (QUAESTIO-APERTA).

evidence_classes.vocabulary_note: TWO SOVEREIGN VOCABULARIES, NEVER MERGED. The NATURA class governs nature's observed regularities (encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md, NA-00's twelve classes in three groups as amended 2026-07-15). The UNI 4-value fence governs UNI's own build status (encyclopedia/CLAIM-LEDGER.md). This plate carries both because the boundary between them IS its subject — and Panel VI draws the look-alike pair that must never merge.

notation_note: NA-04 writes the sparsity conditions with a derivative dot over the variable. This plate prints them expanded — d(dmu/dt)/d(eta) = 0 — because at plate type size the combining dot above (U+0307) renders on the solidus, and a reader would then see the different and false statement d(mu)/d(eta) = 0 (states, not flows). Identical theorem, in a form the page cannot corrupt. Recorded as caption item 5.

design_only.note: Pure static SVG. No script, no on-event handlers, no xlink/href, no @import, no webfont, no remote image.
